identity.real_world_identity_notes: Customer GT3 racing car built on the G82 M4 and powered by the P58 twin-turbo straight-six. Power reaches the rear wheels through a six-speed sequential Xtrac transaxle derived from the M8 GTE programme. Its electro-hydraulic clutch is operated by steering-wheel paddles, so the car has no clutch pedal and includes stall prevention, which matches the clutch-free move-off observed in the drive.

wheel_rim.notes: Observed from the cockpit during the guided drive.

notes: Simulator behavior was directly observed in a guided drive with automatic clutch and shifting disabled: clutch-free move-off, six paddle-selected gears, and automatic cut and blip.
No throttle lift is required on upshifts and no manual blip on downshifts, because the drive detected automatic cut and automatic blip. This matches every other curated paddle-shift GT3 car.
'BMW M4 GT3 - Low Downforce' inherits these verified base controls as an approved aero-package assumption and was not separately live-tested.
